title_zh: 为什么要生成点击？面向网页智能体的插件式决策头

title_zh: STP-GUI：面向高效网页GUI智能体的空间感知token剪枝
one_line: Learned instruction-guided scorer keeps contiguous visual-token windows before the LLM; Online-Mind2Web keeps 77.7% SR at 21% tokens, 31% lower latency.
one_line_zh: 用策略学习训练轻量选择器按窗口保留视觉token，在线Mind2Web上21%保留率保持77.7%性能并降低31%延迟。

online_eval.quote: Online-Mind2Web Xue et al. (2025) is a live web agent benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 136 real websites, using task-level success rate (SR) as the primary metric.

variance.quote: Since Online-Mind2Web is evaluated on live websites, we repeat experiments 3 times under the same protocol and report the mean SR.

strong_baselines.quote: To ensure fair comparison, we evaluate both their original training-free settings and fine-tuned variants adapted on the same SFT data.

budget_matched.quote: Because not all baselines are evaluated at exactly the same keep ratio, we do not claim a strict iso-budget comparison for every entry in Tab. 2 .

cost_reported.quote: At 21% retention, STP-GUI reduces latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57% relative to the dense baseline.

component_ablation.quote: STP-GUI achieves larger improvements of 4.3 and 3.7 percentage points when switching from token-wise to window-wise selection.

evidence_level.quote: Experiments on Online-Mind2Web show that \papername achieves a favorable efficiency-performance tradeoff under low token budgets.

S2.quote: To ensure fair comparison, we evaluate both their original training-free settings and fine-tuned variants adapted on the same SFT data.

F5.quote: At 21% token retention, it preserves 77.7% of full-token performance while reducing inference latency by 31% and FLOPs by 57%.

AP8.quote: This result shows that the optimization strategy affects the achieved performance. Additional training-seed statistics are needed to assess optimization stability.

title_zh: Player-1：从合成经验中学习玩游戏
one_line: Extends CUA action space for games, SFT on demos, then PPO in 16 synthetic reward-verified gyms; MineDojo 10.5->38.3%, gains transfer to ViZDoom/GameWorld.
one_line_zh: 扩展计算机使用动作空间，先用演示SFT再在16个可验证奖励的合成游戏环境中PPO，MineDojo成功率大增并迁移到未训练游戏。

online_eval.quote: Our standardized evaluation protocols use 8 trials per MineDojo task, 50 per ViZDoom map, and 3 per GameWorld task.

held_out_env.quote: The same policy also improves on ViZDoom-10 and GameWorld, both outside the RL training suite.

variance.quote: Coverage counts tasks meeting the success thresholds; brackets show 95% task-bootstrap confidence intervals.

strong_baselines.quote: We also compare the base models, our SFT-initialized models, and the final Player-1 models to separate the gains from SFT and those from synthetic experience.

budget_matched.quote: We keep their native preprocessing and inference procedures across the benchmarks.

cost_reported.quote: Each training step collects 256 episodes allocated equally across environments, with at most 50 interaction turns per episode.

component_ablation.quote: Interactive learning raises 9B success to 38.33%, a large gain of 27.79 percentage points over SFT.

evidence_level.quote: On ViZDoom-10, Player-1-9B increases scaled return from 0.4361 after SFT to 0.6922.

S1.quote: To provide verifiable training feedback, each environment defines game- and task-specific scoring rules over changing game states.

S4.quote: Score increments supply step-level rewards, providing dense and verifiable feedback without a learned judge, while privileged state is not exposed to the policy.

AP2.quote: Together, these results show that control experience acquired in Player-1-Gym transfers to first-person shooting and distinct browser games, beyond the synthesized environments for RL.

title_zh: OpenGCUA：迈向通用计算机使用的完全开放技术栈
one_line: Prompted agent writes programs over GUI, AX-tree, CLI and API and decides its own observations; OSWorld-v2 partial score +19.6 across eight models.
one_line_zh: 让模型以代码程序组合GUI、无障碍树、命令行与API并自主决定观察，OSWorld-v2上八个模型平均部分得分提升19.6。

online_eval.quote: On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points

strong_baselines.quote: Ablations show additional benefits from code execution with the same GUI and CLI access, indicating that execution design matters beyond interface access.

cost_reported.quote: selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra

component_ablation.quote: Ablations show additional benefits from code execution with the same GUI and CLI access, indicating that execution design matters beyond interface access.

code.quote: We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK.

evidence_level.quote: On the offline subset of OSWorld-v2, the full OpenGCUA configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models

S6.quote: raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution.

title_zh: OS-Helix：在原生计算机使用智能体中统一GUI交互与代码执行
one_line: End-to-end policy with unified GUI/code actions, trained on artifact-composed synthesized verifiable tasks plus step-balanced GSPO; OSWorld-Verified 66.44%, transfers to WAA.
one_line_zh: 以应用-文件组合合成可验证任务训练统一GUI与代码动作的端到端策略，并用步级均衡GSPO强化，OSWorld达66.44%并迁移到Windows。

online_eval.quote: OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success.

held_out_env.quote: Removing the nine related application domains shifts success from 62.75% to 62.31%.

variance.quote: Pass@3 from 70.88% to 76.44% (+5.56 points), with the latter supported by a paired-bootstrap confidence interval of 95% [2.24,8.97].

strong_baselines.quote: All reproduced baseline results are evaluated using the same harness and environment configuration.

budget_matched.quote: All entries use a 50-step budget and a hybrid action space.

cost_reported.quote: OS-Helix-27B uses fewer interactions while covering more successes under small step budgets.

component_ablation.quote: Standard GSPO lowers success to 60.47% and increases the code-action rate from 27.9% under the SFT policy to 40.0%

validator_check.quote: Each trajectory is scored by its evaluator, using the teacher model itself when visual judgment is required, and the resulting score serves as the primary signal for rejection sampling.

evidence_level.quote: Table 2 further shows that the gains transfer to WindowsAgentArena, where OS-Helix-27B-RL improves over the Qwen3.5-27B GUI baseline by 23.05 points.

S6.quote: Disabling code for the same policy still yields 52.13% success; enabling it adds 10.62 points, demonstrating retained GUI competence and code complementarity.

AP4.quote: Programmatically observable conditions are evaluated primarily with rule-based checks over VM files and command-line state, while visual conditions that cannot be reliably recovered programmatically are handled with VLM-based evaluation.

AP5.quote: Removing the nine related application domains shifts success from 62.75% to 62.31%.

title_zh: LEASH：面向计算机使用智能体的不确定性感知弱到强升级与监督
one_line: Weak agent's hidden-state distance to past failures gates handoff to Opus and shadow-monitors it; OSWorld beats random escalation by 6.6-11.9 points at matched rates.
one_line_zh: 用弱模型隐状态与历史成败轨迹的距离决定何时移交强模型并在移交后影子监督，OSWorld上同等升级率下显著优于随机升级。

online_eval.quote: With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, LEASH achieves 73.66% task success at $0.4117 per task, matching always-on Claude Opus 5 (72.90%) while reducing inference cost by 19.2%.

budget_matched.quote: At closely matched escalation rates, it also outperforms random task escalation by 6.55–11.94 percentage points

cost_reported.quote: Costs are estimated from recorded token usage at fixed reference prices, including weak agent, Manager, strong-executor, and monitoring calls when enabled.

evidence_level.quote: Experiments on OSWorld across four contemporary model backbones show that LEASH consistently improves over standalone weak agents

title_zh: 不重训，重混：用混合超网络适配网页智能体
one_line: A scout writes a manual of an unseen site; a router mixes a frozen LoRA bank into a new adapter; ~8-point gains on held-out TimeWarp domains.
one_line_zh: 侦察智能体为新网站写简要手册，路由器据此混合已训练LoRA适配器，无需目标梯度更新即可在未见域上提升约8个百分点。

online_eval.quote: A task succeeds if a verifier accepts the final state of the website.

title_zh: 借助用户手册使计算机使用智能体适配新软件
one_line: Retrieves user-manual sections into a planner's procedural plan and trains the CUA with GRPO on manual-derived tasks; OSWorld apps 36.8->47.3% (UI-TARS-1.5).
one_line_zh: 检索用户手册生成程序化计划指导执行，并用手册生成的任务做GRPO训练，在OSWorld五个应用和Slack上提升成功率。

online_eval.quote: Table 1: Task success rates (%) on OSWorld applications under a 50-step budget.

held_out_env.quote: Training is performed separately for each application to evaluate application-specific adaptation.

variance.quote: we evaluate our main models over five independent runs on both OSWorld and Slack and report the mean and standard deviation.

strong_baselines.quote: Bold and underlined values indicate the highest and second-highest mean success rates, respectively, among systems with base CUAs of 8B parameters or fewer.

budget_matched.quote: Table 1: Task success rates (%) on OSWorld applications under a 50-step budget.
